name: Preferred Specimen/Attribute Status
citation: HL7 v2.8.2 Chapter 2C sec 2.C.2.544, HL7 Table 0920 - Preferred Specimen/Attribute Status; its only governing field, OM4-16 (CH08 sec 8.8.12.16), reads "Refer to HL7 Table 0920 - Preferred Specimen/Attribute Status in Chapter 2C, Code Tables, for suggested values", so the printed rows are not a closed set
